purpose: Backfill imageUrl for 66 fully-new configurations (references not present in the pre-existing 725-item catalog and not observed with an image URL by the concurrently-collected Longines Switzerland market evidence) that the original US market/new-market collection run on 2026-09-25 recorded without an imageUrl field. This supplements observations.json; it does not modify or overwrite it.

collectionMethod.tool: chrome-devtools MCP (evaluate_script) against an active longines.com tab
collectionMethod.technique: In-page same-origin fetch() of each product URL's rendered HTML, followed by regex extraction of <meta property="og:image" content="..."> from the response body.

verificationSample.note: Cross-checked via document.querySelector for og:image meta tag and JSON-LD script[type=application/ld+json] image field on the live rendered page (not just fetched HTML); both matched the same URL, confirming the extraction method is reliable for this site.

collectionMethod.rateLimiting: Sequential fetches with a 300ms delay between requests, executed in 4 batches (15/17/17/17) within the same browser tab session; no concurrency increase, no retries needed (all requests returned HTTP 200 on first attempt).
collectionMethod.priorAttempt: Direct curl/HTTP fetch from the sandbox shell (non-browser) was attempted first for a single sample URL and failed with a TLS/HTTP2 connection reset (INTERNAL_ERROR), consistent with anti-bot protection; WebFetch tool succeeded but returns markdown-summarized content without a reliably labeled source field, so the real-browser chrome-devtools approach was used for all 66 records to keep the extraction method verifiable and consistent with browser-web-data-discovery skill guidance.

summary: PASS: 66/66 requested references returned HTTP 200 and yielded an og:image URL matching the https://api.ecom.longines.com/media/catalog/product/... pattern used elsewhere in this collection (e.g. CH market evidence imageUrl/imagePath format). 0 failures, 0 unavailable/delisted pages encountered.
limitations: Only the primary hero image (og:image / JSON-LD ImageObject.url) was captured for each reference; alternate/detail images visible on the page (e.g. *-detailed-view-*.jpg) were not recorded, matching the single imageUrl field required by data/schemas/watch-catalog.schema.json.

Per-record observedAt timestamps were not captured individually inside the batch fetch script; all records in this run share the single observationWindow above rather than a unique per-item timestamp. This is acceptable for an image-URL-only backfill (not a price/listing observation) but is noted as a limitation.
This file does not re-verify price, listingStatus, or nickname data for these 66 references; those remain as recorded in the original observations.json from this same evidence run.
No market/history/catalog files were modified by this task; catalog merge and cross-market reconciliation remain the coordinator's responsibility.
